### Observed differences

- Five activities that never occurred in the earlier window — A19, A20, A25, A26 and A27 — each run in about 17–23 in 100 later cases (A19 about 23, A20 and A25 about 22, A27 about 18, A26 about 17). Their shares together cover practically every later case, and tested pairs of them practically never co-occur (at most about 1 in 100), so a later case typically contains exactly one of them, around the middle of the trace (mean position about 0.5). [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, REL010, REL011, REL016, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005]
- The segment A29 → A30 → A31, previously back-to-back (A29→A30 and A30→A31 adjacent in about 99 and 97 in 100 earlier cases; A29 two positions before A31 in about 97 in 100), now carries one extra step: A29→A30 and A30→A31 are each adjacent in only about half of the later cases (about 48 and 51 in 100), and A29 precedes A31 by three positions in about 95 in 100. [LAG001, LAG002, LAG003]
- The new step sits inside this segment: A29 now leads to the new activities in about half of its outgoing transitions (earlier about 99 in 100 went to A30), and A30 leads to them in about 47 in 100 (earlier about 97 in 100 went to A31); each new activity leads onward to A30 or A31 in roughly equal shares (for example A19: about 50% to A30, 46% to A31). Whenever one of them appears it runs after A29 (about 22 in 100 cases) and before A31 (about 22 in 100), and for A19, A20 and A25 about half of the appearances fall before A30 and half after it. [DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, REL013, REL014, REL015, REL018, REL019, REL022, REL023, REL024]
- A06 tripled its participation (about 8 in 100 earlier cases to about 28 in 100 later) and now occurs late in the case (median position about 0.9 vs about 0.55 earlier); its outgoing transitions, previously spread over many activities (largest share about 25% to A28), now go almost exclusively to A47 (about 85 in 100). A46 now leads to A06 in about a third of its transitions (about 1 in 100 earlier) and A46→A47 fell from about 91 to about 68 in 100, so A06 typically sits between A46 and A47 in later cases; the earlier A46→A06 picture rests on only 2 observations. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, DIR009, REL008, REL009, LAG004, LAG005]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that, in the later window, one additional step is executed within the previously fixed A29 → A30 → A31 sequence: practically every later case inserts exactly one of five alternative activities — A19, A20, A25, A26 or A27 — placed directly before A30 in about half of the cases and directly after A30 in the other half. The relational and positional evidence shows this directly and consistently: the five activities rise from zero participation to about 17–23 in 100 cases with near-zero mutual co-occurrence; A29 and A30 now route about half of their outgoing transitions to them while each of them leads onward to A30 or A31; they run after A29 and before A31 whenever they appear; and all three positional gaps in the segment widened by exactly one step, which distinguishes an insertion from a mere shift in how often existing paths are taken. The volume of qualifying evidence (49 control-flow items against fewer than 1 expected without change) is also far beyond what an unchanged process produces. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, REL010, REL013, REL015, REL018, REL020, REL022, REL024, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003]

The evidence cannot rule out that these five activity codes are relabelled or previously unrecorded occurrences rather than genuinely new steps, and the data do not show why the inserted step falls before A30 in some cases and after it in others. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, REL014, REL019, REL023]

Other differences: A06 roughly tripled its participation (about 8 to about 28 in 100 cases), moved towards the end of the case (median position about 0.9 vs about 0.55), and now typically runs between A46 and A47 (A46 leads to A06 in about a third of its transitions; A06 leads to A47 in about 85 in 100 of its transitions), whereas earlier it was a rare mid-trace activity with successors scattered over many activities. This change appears independent of the inserted step: A06 co-occurs with each new activity about as often as their individual frequencies would suggest (about 5 in 100 cases). [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, DIR009, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL008, REL009, LAG005]

Let me analyse this evidence carefully.

Setup:
- Two windows, 200 traces each.
- Screening: 137 units tested, control_flow family: 49 items qualified, 0.68 expected by chance. 49 items is many times larger than 0.68 — so the count cannot be explained by chance. This is a strong signal that something changed.

Wait — the evidence list contains 25 items (OCC001-006, DIR001-009, POS001-005, REL001-024, LAG001-005). Let me count: OCC: 6, DIR: 9, POS: 5, REL: 24, LAG: 5. Total = 49. Yes, 49 items, matching the screening count of 49. Expected without change: 0.68. So 49 >> 0.68 — the number of items is many times larger than chance expectation. So we move past the "insufficient evidence by count" gate.

Now judge by directness, consistency, and ability to rule out competing explanations.

Let me piece together the behavioural story.

OCC items (occurrence):
- OCC001: A06 — before: participation 7.5% (15/200 traces), mean 0.08/trace; after: participation 27.5% (55/200), mean 0.305. Increased.
- OCC002: A19 — before: 0 participation; after: 23% (46/200). New appearance.
- OCC003: A20 — before: 0; after: 22% (44/200).
- OCC004: A25 — before: 0; after: 22% (44/200).
- OCC005: A26 — before: 0; after: 16.5% (33/200).
- OCC006: A27 — before: 0; after: 17.5% (35/200).

So five activities (A19, A20, A25, A26, A27) were absent in the before window and appear in roughly 17–23% of traces in the after window. A06 increased from ~7.5% to ~27.5%.

DIR items (outgoing transitions of source activity):
- DIR001: A06 — before: outgoing spread over many activities (A28 25%, A31 12.5%, others 6.25% each); after: overwhelmingly A47 (85%), with small shares to A29, A48, A15, A30, A13, A14, A44, A16. So A06's outgoing transitions changed drastically: before it led to a scattered set (A28, A31, etc.), after it leads mostly to A47.
- DIR002: A19 — before: empty (A19 not observed); after: A19 leads to A30 (50%), A31 (45.7%), A18 (2%), A06 (2%).
- DIR003: A20 — after: A31 (52%), A30 (43%), A35 (2%), A39 (2%).
- DIR004: A25 — after: A30 (50%), A31 (47.7%), A02 (2%).
- DIR005: A26 — after: A30 (60.6%), A31 (36.4%), A23 (3%).
- DIR006: A27 — after: A31 (51.4%), A30 (48.6%).
- DIR007: A29 — before: A29 → A30 (98.5%); after: A29 → A30 (47%), plus A19 (12%), A25 (11.4%), A26 (10%), A20 (9%), A27 (8.5%), small others. So A29 now leads to the new activities.
- DIR008: A30 — before: A30 → A31 (97.5%); after: A30 → A31 (51.5%), A20 (11.4%), A19 (10.4%), A25 (10.4%), A27 (8.4%), A26 (6.4%), small others. So A30 now leads to the new activities about half the time.
- DIR009: A46 — before: A46 → A47 (91%); after: A46 → A47 (68%), A06 (32%). So A46 now sometimes leads to A06.

POS items (position within trace):
- POS001: A06 — before: mean position ~0.48 (middle of trace), median 0.55; after: mean ~0.81, median ~0.90. So A06 moved from mid-trace to late in the trace (position-wise). Support 15 → 55.
- POS002: A19 — after: mean position ~0.50 (middle).
- POS003: A20 — after: mean ~0.51.
- POS004: A25 — after: mean ~0.51.
- POS005: A26 — after: mean ~0.50.

REL items (relations between pairs):
- REL001–004: A06 with A19/A20/A25/A26 — before: A06 alone in ~7.5% of traces, neither ~92.5%; after: co-occurrence ~4.5–6.5%, A_only ~21–23%, B_only ~10–17.5%, neither ~55–62.5%. So both now occur, mostly not together.
- REL005: A06 & A29 — before: B_only (A29 only) 92.5%, co-occurrence 7.5%; after: co-occurrence 27.5%, B_only 72.5%, B_before_A 23%. So A06 now co-occurs with A29 much more, and when both occur, A29 comes before A06 (B_before_A 23% vs A_before_B 1.5%).
- REL006: A06 & A30 — same pattern: co-occurrence 7.5% → 27.5%, B_before_A 3.5% → 23.5%.
- REL007: A06 & A31 — same: co-occurrence 7.5% → 27.5%, B_before_A 2.5% → 23%, A_before_B 4.5% → 1.5%.
- REL008: A06 & A46 — before: co-occurrence 5%, B_only 57.5%, neither 35%; after: co-occurrence 26%, B_only 32%, neither 40.5%, B_before_A 17.5% (A46 before A06), interleaved 8.5%.
- REL009: A06 & A47 — before: co-occurrence 5%, B_only 57%; after: co-occurrence 26%, A_before_B 17.5% (A06 before A47), B_only 32%.
- REL010: A19 & A20 — before: neither 100%; after: A_only 22%, B_only 21%, neither 56%, co-occurrence 1%. So A19 and A20 are alternatives (rarely together).
- REL011: A19 & A25 — before: neither 100%; after: A_only 23%, B_only 22%, neither 55%. Alternatives.
- REL012: A19 & A26 — similar.
- REL013: A19 & A29 — before: B_only 100% (A29 always, A19 never); after: co-occurrence 23%, B_only 77%, B_before_A 22.5%. So A19 occurs after A29 in ~22.5% of traces.
- REL014: A19 & A30 — before: B_only 100%; after: co-occurrence 23%, B_before_A 10.5%, A_before_B 12.5%. Mixed order.
- REL015: A19 & A31 — before: B_only 100%; after: co-occurrence 23%, A_before_B 22.5%. So A19 before A31.
- REL016: A20 & A25 — before: neither 100%; after: A_only 22%, B_only 22%. Alternatives.
- REL017: A20 & A26 — similar.
- REL018: A20 & A29 — before: B_only 100%; after: co-occurrence 22%, B_before_A 21.5%. A20 after A29.
- REL019: A20 & A30 — before: B_only 100%; after: co-occurrence 22%, mixed order (A_before_B 10%, B_before_A 12%).
- REL020: A20 & A31 — before: B_only 100%; after: co-occurrence 22%, A_before_B 21.5%. A20 before A31.
- REL021: A25 & A26 — before: neither 100%; after: A_only 22%, B_only 16.5%. Alternatives.
- REL022: A25 & A29 — before: B_only 100%; after: co-occurrence 22%, B_before_A 22%. A25 after A29.
- REL023: A25 & A30 — before: B_only 100%; after: co-occurrence 22%, mixed order.
- REL024: A25 & A31 — before: B_only 100%; after: co-occurrence 22%, A_before_B 22%. A25 before A31.

LAG items (distance in positions between ordered pair within five steps):
- LAG001: A29→A30 — before: distance 1 in 99%; after: distance 1 in 47.5%, distance 2 in 51%. So the gap between A29 and A30 widened from immediately adjacent to often one step apart.
- LAG002: A29→A31 — before: distance 2 in 97%; after: distance 3 in 95%. Gap widened by one.
- LAG003: A30→A31 — before: distance 1 in 97%; after: distance 1 in 51.5%, distance 2 in 47%. Gap widened.
- LAG004: A46→A06 — before: support only 2 observations (distance 1 in 50%, 3 in 50%); after: 52 observations, distance 1 in 74%, distance 4 in 8%. Weak before support.
- LAG005: A46→A47 — before: distance 1 in 47%, 2 in 5%; after: distance 1 in 32%, 2 in 22%. Slight redistribution.

Now let me synthesize the story:

Before window: A29 → A30 → A31 ran as a tight sequence (A29→A30 distance 1, A30→A31 distance 1, A29→A31 distance 2). A06 occurred in ~7.5% of traces around mid-position, with scattered outgoing transitions. A19, A20, A25, A26, A27 never occurred.

After window: In roughly 17–23% of traces, a new block of activities A19, A20, A25, A26, A27 appears (they are mutually exclusive alternatives — REL010, 011, 012, 016, 017, 021 show they rarely co-occur). This block is inserted between A29/A30 and A31: A29 and A30 now lead to these new activities (DIR007, DIR008), the new activities lead to A30 and A31 (DIR002–006), the new activities occur after A29 (REL013, 018, 022: B_before_A ~22%) and before A31 (REL015, 020, 024: A_before_B ~22%), and the gaps A29→A30, A30→A31, A29→A31 widened by one step (LAG001–003). A06 also increased in participation (7.5% → 27.5%) and now occurs late in the trace (position ~0.9 vs ~0.55), mostly after A29/A30/A46 (REL005–008: B_before_A) and before A47 (REL009: A_before_B 17.5%). A06's outgoing transitions now go overwhelmingly to A47 (85%).

So the main hypothesis: a new optional block of activities (A19, A20, A25, A26, A27 — apparently alternatives, one of which is chosen) was inserted into the sequence between A29/A30 and A31, executed in about one in five traces. This is supported directly by:
- OCC002–006: new activities appear from zero to ~17–23%.
- DIR002–006: the new activities lead to A30/A31.
- DIR007/008: A29 and A30 now lead to the new activities.
- REL013/018/022 (and 014, 019, 023): new activities occur after A29 (and around A30).
- REL015/020/024: new activities occur before A31.
- LAG001–003: the distances A29→A30, A30→A31, A29→A31 each widened by about one step, consistent with an insertion between them.
- REL010/011/012/016/017/021: the new activities are alternatives to each other (rarely co-occur).

This is a coherent, direct, consistent story. The insertion hypothesis is well supported: the LAG widening is direct positional evidence of insertion; the DIR and REL evidence shows the new activities sit between A29/A30 and A31.
